rv.q: It's a very peculiar show indeed, with an unvarying and unpleasant tone of careless sexualisation.
The only critical tactic to adopt is one of either submission or resentment, and I veered violently between both conditions as the music crashed about me like huge waves on Surfers’ Paradise.

cn.t: Critics find this '80s hair metal musical largely resistible, with its Sunset Strip nostalgia and jukebox rock catalog failing to connect beyond existing fans of the genre.
